name: hbg-epic-giant-worlds
description: Three HBG Agent Skills for keyword colossal worlds, Eastern colossal adaptation, and roaming a public 475-prompt archive.

interface.shortDescription: Turn keywords and prompt banks into colossal cinematic worlds.
interface.longDescription: Three reusable Agent Skills expand a keyword into a colossal world, convert ideas into a consistent luminous Eastern colossal aesthetic, and roam a bundled public archive of 475 source prompts while preserving provenance and rewriting every image and motion prompt.
defaultPrompt: 把“冰岛”扩写成四个不同视角的巨物世界。
把“弹琴”转换成明亮空灵的东方巨物母图与视频方案。
随机漫游四个题目，并统一改写成东方巨物风格。
